title: Activation grouping: Apparatus of the Crab (one action, up to two levers) and Candle of Invocation (one action to light)
description:
RECONCILED 2026-10-18 after the architectural boundary review. This supersedes the 2026-10-17 framing where the two differ; the original text is kept verbatim in NOTES.

This is a PRE-FREEZE source-semantics and design resolution: it blocks eshyra-o9bd.14.

SOURCE
- Apparatus of the Crab: "A creature in the compartment can use an action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position."
- Candle of Invocation: "The candle's magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires an action. After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute ..." and "Alternatively, when you light the candle for the first time, you can cast the gate spell with it. Doing so destroys the candle."

CURRENT STATE (origin/main 318a7eb6, PR #673 head)
- Apparatus: 11 set-lever-N operations, each moving one lever, with no typed cost. Each triage-stateMachine-op-set-lever-N clause is engine-pending on F2 'activation action economy', F5 and F9.
- Candle: the burn (budget, 1-minute increments) and cast-gate (single-use, excludes burn) operations have no typed cost.
- Both items are recorded in UNTYPED_ACTIVATION_PHRASE_DISPOSITIONS (magicItemActivationCostLedger.ts) as ambiguous and therefore absent.
- Correction to the original "No engine claim depends on it": the absence keeps those clauses honestly pending rather than making a false claim. But action accounting for these items is not authoritative today.

THE DECISION TO MAKE
Represent or adjudicate the printed action grouping faithfully, while keeping action accounting and state mutation authoritative.
- Apparatus: ONE action moves up to TWO levers. Never charge one action per lever mutation, and never allow a third lever in the same action.
- Candle: ONE action lights the candle. Subsequent burn-time updates cost no action. The gate cast is the first-light alternative: the lighting action, and the candle is destroyed; the spell's own semantics are adjudicated.

Candidate shapes, for the decider and not prescriptive:
- Apparatus: a single item-local operation that takes 1–2 lever selections and pays one action; or the DM adjudicates the grouping while the engine spends exactly one action per adjudicated use.
- Candle: a light operation that pays the action and starts the burn, while the burn deduction stays action-free.

NOT REQUIRED: a generalized multi-operation action framework (absent an independently justified requirement); vehicle movement, depth, air supply or geometry for the Apparatus (DM); the effects of the Candle's light zone or its spellcasting (separate hooks).
acceptance_criteria:
1. Decision recorded per item: the supported operation(s), their exclusions, and the remaining DM responsibility.
2. Authoritative action accounting:
   - Apparatus: one action covers one or two lever moves; a third lever needs another action.
   - Candle: one action to light; burn-time updates cost no action; first-light gate = the lighting action plus destruction.
3. The ledger entries (UNTYPED_ACTIVATION_PHRASE_DISPOSITIONS) and the typed costs are updated to match the decision. The pack is regenerated with a thaw note if records change.
4. Minimum permanent evidence: a real-pack test of the printed grouping for each item (two levers for one action and a third refused within the same action; light once, then action-free burn updates). This is not a per-lever matrix.
5. Not required: see NOT REQUIRED in the description.

ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION (2026-10-17, superseded where the reconciled description differs):
Found in eshyra-xwau.1: Apparatus of the Crab prints ONE action for moving up to TWO levers while each set-lever-N operation moves one; Candle of Invocation prints that LIGHTING requires an action but burn/cast-gate model continuous burn time / a gate cast. Faithful typing cannot be distinguished cheaply, so both stay untyped (see magicItemActivationCostLedger.ts UNTYPED_ACTIVATION_PHRASE_DISPOSITIONS). Needs a design decision (e.g. a per-use grouping or a separate light-candle operation) before any cost can be typed. No engine claim depends on it.
